| `optics_gfx_curve_seg_offset_retrograde` | Retrograde interval of an offset segment. |
| `optics_gfx_curve_seg_bounds` | Conservative control-hull bounds of a reduced segment. |
| `optics_gfx_curve_seg_ray_x` | x-coordinates where the segment crosses the horizontal line y = yv, in ascending order, at most 2, over the closed parameter domain [0,1]. |
| `optics_gfx_curve_cover_bounds` | Conservative bounds of a run of segments. |
| `optics_gfx_curve_cover_winding` | Signed winding number of the closed path at (x, y): +1 per upward crossing of the ray to +x, −1 per downward crossing. |
| `optics_gfx_curve_cover_contains` | Inside test under `rule`. |
| `optics_gfx_curve_cover_coverage` | Coverage of the pixel square [x, x+1) x [y, y+1) under `rule`, from an n x n grid of winding samples. |

### `<optics/gfx/sdf.h>`

| Symbol | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `optics_gfx_sdf_circle` | Exact. |
| `optics_gfx_sdf_round_rect` | Exact, and `radius == 0` is a plain box. |
| `optics_gfx_sdf_ring` | Border of half-width `half` around a shape whose signed distance is `d`: the ring is the set \|d\| <= half. |
| `optics_gfx_sdf_squircle` | Squircle / continuous-curvature field: a rounded rectangle whose corner arc blends a circular arc (`curvature == 0`, where this is *exactly* optics_gfx_sdf_round_rect) with an L4 superellipse corner (`curvature == 1`, the "G2 squircle"). |

| `optics_ui_caret_rect` | Caret rect of the focused text widget in UI-space, zero when none. |
| `optics_ui_caret_visible` | Current caret blink phase: true while the caret is in its visible half of the blink cycle (ADR-0151). |
| `optics_ui_set_caret_blink` | Override the caret blink period in seconds. |
| `optics_ui_caret_flip_pending` | True when the caret's blink phase differs from the phase the last activated snapshot put on screen (ADR-0151). |
| `optics_ui_caret_clock_live` | True when a caret blink clock is running: a text widget holds focus and the blink is enabled (ADR-0151). |

| `optics_ui_copy` | Place text on the system clipboard (calls the host optics_ui_clipboard.set_text if any). |
| `optics_ui_request_paste` | Ask the host for clipboard text (calls optics_ui_clipboard.request_text). |
| `optics_ui_paste` | Host-driven delivery of clipboard text into ui. |
| `optics_ui_take_paste` | Drain a pending paste payload for an app-owned editing surface (one that renders text outside ui widgets and therefore has no focused widget to consume the queue). |
| `optics_ui_set_caret_rect` | Report the caret rect of an app-owned editing surface, same consumer as the widget-reported rect: the platform layer forwards it to the IME so the candidate window follows the caret. |

| `optics_ui_take_drop` | Retrieve and consume pending drop payload during drop frame. |

## app — application shell

### `<optics/app.h>`

| Symbol | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `optics_app_run` | Run the application until its window closes. |
| `optics_app_quit` | Request the active application window to close cleanly. |
| `optics_app_request_frame` | Request one more frame at the display's active animation cadence. |
| `optics_app_post` | Thread-safe: post `fn(user)` to run on the application main thread. |
| `optics_app_get_geometry` | Query the active application window's logical size. |
